readings.summary: Add a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute for partial formatter classes; the generator emits the formatter body for T in contractless mode over public members, honoring any MessagePack attributes already on T, with no surrogate type or extra settings.
readings.code_difference: Defines only a parameterless attribute (shipped by the library/generator package), discovers annotated partial classes implementing IMessagePackFormatter<T>, and emits Serialize/Deserialize into that class using contractless defaults when T lacks [MessagePackObject]/[DataContract]; no SurrogateType property or key-mapping mechanism.

readings.summary: Also provide a configuration mechanism (e.g. SurrogateType, or a way to specify keys/union settings) on the attribute so that T can be customized without attributes on T.
readings.code_difference: The attribute gains additional members (such as SurrogateType or key/union options) and the generator reads a surrogate type or user-defined attribute copies to map keys and unions, which the minimal reading would not implement.

output.quote: For attribute-based property keys and other settings (such as Union), the issue lists three alternatives: (1) use `System.Runtime.Serialization.DataMember` and related attributes; (2) let the generator and analyzers work with user-defined copies of the MessagePack attributes; (3) source-generate the attributes themselves via `RegisterPostInitializationOutput`.
